_about: Release schedules the desks' sources publish, read from the source pages on 2026-11-10 (notify.py builds /calendar.ics and /<desk>/calendar.ics from this file). Only dates the source itself states. Each event cites its schedule page. Add a date only after reading it on the source page, with the read date in 'read'.

sources.title: EIA Short-Term Energy Outlook release
sources.note: EIA states the STEO is normally released between 12:00 pm and 12:15 pm Eastern Time on the release date.

sources.title: NOAA CPC long-lead seasonal outlook release
sources.note: CPC states the forecast is generally released around 8:30 AM Eastern Time on the scheduled date, on the third Thursday of the month. CPC says its 2027 schedule will be released on or about 2 December 2026.

sources.title: NHC hurricane season
sources.note: NHC states the Atlantic hurricane season runs from June 1 to November 30 and the eastern Pacific season from May 15 to November 30.

events.label: Atlantic and eastern Pacific seasons end
Atlantic and eastern Pacific seasons end

sources.title: FOMC meeting with a Summary of Economic Projections
sources.note: The Federal Reserve marks these meetings as associated with a Summary of Economic Projections and states that each meeting date is tentative until confirmed at the meeting before it.
